subject: Insurance
title: Medical Bankruptcy
description: A quick, practical guide to Medical Bankruptcy.

hook.text: About 530,000 US families go bankrupt from medical bills each year. Two-thirds of them had insurance when they got sick.

buildup.text: High deductibles, out-of-network charges, and gaps in coverage leave patients with bills they can't pay.

discovery.text: Medical debt is the number one cause of bankruptcy in the US. No other wealthy nation has this problem at this scale.

twist.text: Hospital billing errors are rampant. Studies show 80% of medical bills contain mistakes.

punchline.text: 530,000 medical bankruptcies a year. Most had insurance. It wasn't enough.

quiz.question: What percentage of medical bankruptcy filers had insurance?
